implementation_outline: Validate required columns and supported file formats.
Generate type, range, uniqueness and missingness summaries.
Produce reusable summaries and suitable charts.
Test against two differently shaped, compatible datasets.
answer.acceptance_summary: It works with more than one compatible synthetic/public dataset without rewriting the analysis code.

explanation: Reference solution outline for “Dataset Explorer”. This is a review guide, not a claim that a complete, executable reference implementation has been built or run. A reviewer should verify functionality, statistical assumptions, tests, security and reproducibility before publishing.
